Kamianka-Dniprovska Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Kamianka-Dniprovska — known as Malaya Znamenka until 1920, then Kamianka-na-Dnipri until 1944 — had a Jewish prayer house documented by 1885. In September 1941, 31 Jewish refugees were murdered here, and about 20 local Jews were taken to Nikopol, documented elsewhere in this collection, and shot there in February 1942. This cemetery was gradually demolished as a result of the construction of the Kakhovka Reservoir in the 1950s; some remains from newer burials were reinterred elsewhere by relatives beforehand. An ohel that once stood here was dismantled over time, according to local residents, and the site continues to be regularly vandalized by grave robbers.
